title: Marketplace lockfile (IMP-0084)
description: Resolved package pins written by tools/marketplace/lockfile.py:generate_lockfile and enforced by install_verified. Every package pins the exact bytes that were resolved: name, version, source_url and a content digest. A fetched blob whose digest differs from the pinned one is refused before any write (no retry). The lockfile pins bits, not provenance: there is no generation_method / AI-provenance field here (RES-0125 measures that gap); such metadata belongs to the package manifest, not the lock.

lockfile_version.description: Lockfile format version. Version 1 is the only one defined.

resolver_version.description: Version of the resolver that produced the pins. A stale resolver warns and still enforces the digest.

packages.description: Sorted by (name, version) so the same set of packages always serialises to the same bytes.

source_url.description: Where the resolver fetched the package bytes from; install_verified re-fetches from here and compares digests.

sha256.description: Flat mirror of digest.hex kept for readers written against lockfile_version 1 rows before the digest object existed.
